codeReview.summary: Fail. The current repo state does not resolve the prior blocking findings for this feature: the relevant implementation and test files are unchanged from the original feature commit, so attendance access is still date-literal-only and not tenant-scoped, while weather enrichment still trusts arbitrary farm IDs and falls back to Nashik coordinates when the selected farm has no location.

issues.description: `parseExplicitDate()` still only recognizes literal `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, and `queryWorkers()` only reads `worker_attendance` when that parser succeeds. Prompts like 'worker attendance today' or local-language equivalents therefore still fall through to the generic active-worker summary instead of querying attendance data, so VAL-BE-009 remains unmet. The current HEAD is unchanged from the original feature commit for this code path.

The attendance lookup still filters only by `date` and an optional `farm_ids` contains check. It never constrains rows by the authenticated user's worker IDs or farm ownership, so when `farmId` is omitted it can still read other tenants' attendance rows for that day. That leaves the VAL-BE-025 user-/farm-scoping requirement unresolved.

`fetchFarmDetails()` still trusts any supplied `farmId` and filters only by `id`, with no ownership check. `fetchWeatherData()` still falls back to hard-coded Nashik coordinates at lines 1341-1342 when the farm has no location, so advisory requests can still receive irrelevant or unauthorized weather context instead of skipping weather enrichment. The prior VAL-BE-025 / VAL-BE-031 failure is therefore still present.

`assembleContext()` still excludes `farmRecordsContext.citations` from the returned `citations` array, so downstream consumers only see memory/RAG/weather citations even when farm-backed context was loaded successfully.
